item.title: Shrinkwrap 0.25.3
item.description: New: @cascade — put it on a tagged folder and its other tags apply to every plain subfolder below it, each processed as its own folder (@below, @downstream and @throughout say the same thing). @inherit now works on its own and on subfolders with names of their own, taking the enclosing folder's tags. A subfolder with tags of its own always keeps its own scope.
